renderer.engine:
rsvg-convert version 2.63.3

libraries used:
  cairo 1.18.6
  pango 1.58.2
  harfbuzz 14.6.0
  fontconfig 2.18.3
renderer.source: Original SVG geometry and reusable technical glyphs
renderer.device_semantics: Logical service and analysis roles, not measured physical/VPS deployment
renderer.graph_semantics: Illustrative maintainer/package/repository topology; counts and displayed result are empirical

text_metric_methods: Fixed conservative text-box widths with native left/center/right alignment; no font-measurement dependency
limitations: Glyph internals and decorative paths are independent SVG image cells; text, rectangles and routes are native editable cells.
Text requests Noto Sans with approximate baseline placement; browser font rendering can require minor adjustment after import.
Connector terminal attachment is inferred from nearby glyph bounds; publication SVG/PDF remains the authoritative visual.
XML structure and geometry were checked programmatically; interactive draw.io import was not exercised.

scope: Repeated export hashes, exact partition checks in source verification, embedded fonts and draw.io document structure; SVG/PDF visual inspection at intended print size. Draw.io editor rendering was not inspected.
